method.rule: A capability is a behavior boundary with a contract and verification surface; provisional provenance buckets are evidence containers only. Runtime policy and diagnostics are split when a historical change both changes behavior and measures it. method.non_capability_rule: Research, operations, benchmarks, integration topology, and isolated maintenance are accounted explicitly without promotion to capabilities.
